title: Vivo Media Arts Centre

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: VIVO Media Arts Centre supports media artists in our community by providing space rentals for production shoots, documentation, rehearsals, podcast recording, or any other production based activity including public events. As a part of VIVO's mandate we offer subsidies for non-profit organizations, and individual artists. Subsidies are based on operational budget size. VIVO’s Studio Space is a large converted warehouse that can be booked for screenings, A/V presentations, performances, installations, meetings, conferences, receptions, or other private functions. Public, evening and weekend events have additional costs including staffing, permits, and cleaning

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: VIVO is located in the sacred homelands of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam) Sḵwx̱wú7mesh (Squamish), and səl̓ílwətaɬ (Tsleil-Waututh) peoples in a warehouse space at 2625 Kaslo Street south of East Broadway at the end of E 10th. Transit line 9 stops at Kaslo Street on Broadway. From the bus stop, the path is paved, curbless, and on a slight decline. The closest skytrain station is Renfrew Station, which is three blocks south-east of VIVO and has an elevator. From there, the path is paved, curbless, and on a slight incline.
